defects_found.title: Directory pushed receipt is false-SAFE when any local-only content is present
defects_found.reproduction: In /tmp/souji-r5-directory-push.tCOxgS, committed docs/published.txt, set master and origin/master to that commit, then created untracked docs/local-only.txt. `git status --short -- docs` showed `?? docs/local-only.txt`; `git log --diff-filter=A --format=%H -1 -- docs` returned the pushed seed commit; `git merge-base --is-ancestor <seed> refs/remotes/origin/master` returned 0. Both installed tools nevertheless returned SAFE(pushed) for the docs directory. Removing that directory would lose local-only.txt.
defects_found.recommendation: Do not grant `pushed` to directories from one introducing commit. Require a directory-wide content receipt or return NOT-SAFE for directory targets without one; add the isolated local-only-directory case to both suites.

defects_found.title: Temporary prune locks are no longer protecting the retained registrations
defects_found.reproduction: `git -C game-dev-2d-shokunin worktree prune -n -v` currently prints Removing lines for wt-r98, wt-r99, wt-r100. `git -C game-dev-2d-shokunin worktree list --porcelain` marks all three prunable. `git log --oneline refs/heads/wt-r98 --not --remotes` (and r99/r100) returns one commit each.
defects_found.impact: A future bare prune can discard the three registration/admin records; the unpushed branch refs and commits remain. This seat performed dry-run only.
